review_quotes.author: Raylet Rodrigues
review_quotes.text: Resort is very good with places for selfie photos. Its well maintained and clean. The only thing is its located at a slope so elder may find it difficult. Food was good...Usually resorts dont offer mutton but they had mutton in the dinner menu and fish curry in the afternoon menu

review_quotes.author: Jayesh Sharma
review_quotes.text: This is budget paradise at the edge of Mumbai where you can plan a weekend with loved ones and family. A pocket of green with smartly planned rooms and a Insta friendly ambience.
